m: stha mf(ā)n. (or ṣṭha) (only ifc.) standing, staying, abiding, being situated in, existing or being in or on or among (see agni-, garbha-, jala-, naraka-, rājya-stha &c.)
occupied with, engaged in, devoted to performing, practising (see dhyāna-, yajña-, yoga-, savana-stha &c.)
a: stha a. (At the end of comp.) Standing, staying, abiding, being, existing &c.; tatrastha, aṃkastha, prakṛtistha, taṭastha q.q. v.v. — sthaḥ A place, spot.
